chapters.title: The goal: skills that handle new geometry
chapters.caption: Collecting a new demonstration for every shape is expensive. SimScale generates assets and robot training data in simulation.

chapters.title: 1. Agents author a category generator
chapters.caption: AssetEngine turns an object description into parameterized code. Coverage and geometry feedback guide revisions.

chapters.title: 2. Procedural code samples the asset family
chapters.caption: Reuse the accepted generator to vary shape and size. Sampling does not need a new agent conversation for every asset.

chapters.title: 3. Start from one human demonstration
chapters.caption: A human reference supplies the skill. DemoEngine decomposes its semantic stages and authors an executable task program.

chapters.title: 4. Agents adapt the task across geometries
chapters.caption: Object-centric targets and simulation feedback guide asset-specific adaptation. Retain source trajectories that complete the task.

chapters.title: 5. DexMimicGen expands poses
chapters.caption: Transform and re-execute accepted source trajectories across object poses. Keep valid executions for imitation learning.

chapters.title: 6. Train in simulation. Test on real objects.
chapters.caption: Train visuomotor policies on the generated data. Evaluate transfer on held-out simulation assets and unseen physical objects.
